public_rationale: The profitability parenthesis can be investigated separately, but it does not settle this complete claim. “Impossible rate” has no defined threshold, financing assumptions, or feasibility test. The surrounding spending figures could support a calculation of required growth under chosen assumptions; they cannot establish impossibility without those additions. The counterfactual wording is not a conditional forecast awaiting an antecedent.
limitations: This does not endorse or reject the separate profitability assertion.
A demanding growth requirement is not, by itself, evidence that growth is impossible.
